Subject: Proposed full-loop for Ava Thompson (SWE)

Hi Stephanie / Laura —

The candidate (Ava Thompson) is excited to move forward with a virtual full-loop. She is based in PST and prefers morning slots. Attached is her resume (Ava_Thompson_resume.pdf).

Proposed times (all PST):
- Tue Jun 8, 9:30–10:15 — System design (60 min buffer)
- Tue Jun 8, 11:00–11:45 — Behavioral + role fit
- Tue Jun 8, 13:00–14:00 — Live coding (pairing)
- Tue Jun 8, 15:00–15:30 — Hiring manager sync

Notes:
- She has one brief window (12:00–12:30) blocked for a phone call — prefer not to schedule then.
- Resume and a short portfolio link are attached.

Can you confirm panel sequencing and who owns the debrief? We can also move slots earlier if needed.

Thanks —
Angela Ruiz
Senior Recruiter, TalentNow

From: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie_nguyen@redwood.com>
To: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>, Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-05-30T10:05:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Proposed full-loop for Ava Thompson (SWE)

Thanks Angela — copying the interview team to lock sequencing and debrief owner. I attached a quick debrief template (debrief-template.xlsx) for async notes; whoever owns hiring-manager sync should compile final feedback.

Suggested flow (to reduce context switching and allow scoring immediately after each panel):
1) System design — Karthik (60m buffer to let him finish notes)
2) Live coding (pairing) — Jonas (we'll do the coding earlier so candidate energy is high)
3) Behavioral/role-fit — Laura (close with role-level questions)
4) HM sync — Stephanie (15–30 min wrap)

If Jonas can't take coding at 13:00, swap with system design, but prefer coding before behavioral. Also: please add a short rubric section for "production-readiness" and "architecture trade-offs" in the debrief template.

Marissa — can you confirm the backup interviewer(s) in case someone drops?

- Stephanie
Director, Engineering Hiring (Redwood Inference)
(attachment: debrief-template.xlsx)

From: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
To: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie_nguyen@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>, Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-05-30T11:03:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Proposed full-loop for Ava Thompson (SWE)

Stephanie — sounds good. Quick ask: can we move live coding to 11:00–12:00 and then put system design at 13:00? My rationale is twofold: coding early helps us assess problem-solving while she's fresh, and system design is heavier for the interviewer — better later with a short break.

Jonas — are you available 11:00–12:00? If not, Karthik can do coding and Jonas can take design.

I'll take behavioral as planned. Happy to own final scorecard after HM sync if that helps consolidate.

Laura
VP Engineering (Hiring Panel Lead)

Hi Ava — great to meet you over email and excited to confirm your virtual full-loop on Tue, Jun 8 (all times PST). See schedule below and a couple of prep notes. Calendar invite (full-loop-invite.ics) attached.

Schedule (PST):
- 11:00–12:00 — Live coding (Jonas Weber) — pair-programming exercise (we'll send the IDE link at start)
- 13:00–14:00 — System design (Karthik Iyer) — small-system design prompt and discussion
- 14:15–15:00 — Behavioral / role fit (Laura Bennett)
- 15:15–15:45 — Hiring manager sync (Stephanie Nguyen)

Prep notes:
- For coding: bring a laptop with normal dev tools; we'll use a shared editor (we'll send instructions 10m before).
- For system design: focus on trade-offs and how you'd measure success.
- We expect to have an asynchronous debrief after each panel; you don't need to do anything there — it's internal.

If anything changes, Angela (cc'd) will coordinate. Looking forward to it.

Best,
Stephanie Nguyen
